installCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix frontend install; elif [ -f ../frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ../frontend install; else npm install; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -rf build && cp -R frontend/build build; elif [ -f ../frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ../frontend run build && rm -rf build && cp -R ../frontend/build build; else npm run build; fi
